title: PaymentProcessed
description: Emitted when a payment finishes processing (e.g. ACH settlement). Replaces the monolith's synchronous account-balance and loan-payoff updates: downstream domains consume this to update their own state.

aggregateId.description: Identifier of the aggregate (the payment id).

status.description: Terminal status of the payment after processing.

principalApplied.description: Principal portion applied; the account domain uses this to reduce the balance.

totalCompletedToDate.description: Sum of completed payments for the loan; the loan domain uses this to decide payoff/closure.
